# Copilot instructions for Cờ Chill

Cờ Chill is a Vietnamese-first Xiangqi learning site. Entry point: `co_chill_server.py` serving `online-preview/`.
Production is https://cochill.vn. The owner reviews every change; another reviewer (Claude) reads the full diff.

## Scope (most important)
- Change only the files and the exact places named in the prompt. If a fix seems to need another file, stop and report it instead.
- Many lines in `online-preview/*.js` are very long. When you edit one part of a long line, keep every other character of that line unchanged. Do not "tidy" wording, labels or `aria-label` text you were not asked to touch.
- Do not rename, move or delete files. Do not add dependencies or install anything.
- Do not run `git add`, `git commit`, `git push`, or rewrite history. The owner commits.
- Never test against or call the production site.

## Report
- End with a report: for each change, the file, the code before and after, and why.
- List anything you noticed but did not change.
- Include the output of `python tools/run_checks.py` (and any test named in the prompt).

## Chess truth
- Legal moves and analysis come from the rules (`online-preview/xiangqi.js`, `app/rules.py`) and the engine. Never invent moves, lines or evaluations in text.
- Never show a solution before the learner's reflection. No coaching during a live game.
- `online-preview/fixtures.js` is generated by `python tools/export_preview_fixtures.py`. Do not edit it by hand.
- Lesson text uses Vietnamese notation (X9.5, M7.6, P2-5). Red files: column a = 9 … i = 1. Black files: column a = 1 … i = 9.

## Language and translation
- Every Vietnamese string a user can see needs English: interface text in `online-preview/i18n-en-ui.js`, lesson content in `online-preview/content-en.js`. Terminology: `docs/I18N_GLOSSARY.md`.
- Do not edit the translation files or `tools/test_i18n_en.cjs` unless the prompt asks. If `node tools/test_i18n_en.cjs` reports untranslated or stale strings, copy them word for word into the report so the owner can get them translated.
- Text typed by users (names, answers, notes) must carry `data-no-translate`. Default placeholder text must not.

## Tests
- Do not weaken, skip or delete failing tests. Fix the code, or report the failure.
- After editing anything in `online-preview/`, run `python tools/stamp_static_versions.py`. It rewrites the `?v=` stamps in `index.html`, `app.js` and `v6-ui.js`, and `run_checks.py` fails if they are out of date. Do not edit stamps by hand.
